analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of https://hub.qovery.com/docs covered 1,301 pages with 100% crawl completion. Critical issues identified: 98 confirmed broken internal links within user-facing documentation, 0% API reference coverage despite 619 API pages detected, and 0% example reliability (likely detection limitation due to JS-rendered code blocks). SEO/metadata issues affect 16.24% of pages. Only 41.97% of pages display last-updated timestamps, hindering freshness transparency. Overall audit confidence stands at 72.11%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved: 1,301 of 1,397 discovered pages crawled (100%)
No repository navigation broken links (repo_broken_links_count: 0), indicating clean GitHub/GitLab integration
Large API surface detected (619 API pages), demonstrating comprehensive API documentation presence
Zero crawl trap URLs encountered, indicating well-structured site architecture
High crawl confidence at 95%, validating thoroughness of site examination
risks: 98 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing docs create poor user experience and erode trust
0% API reference coverage means no usage examples, code samples, or integration guidance detected on 619 API pages
Example reliability at 0% across all pages suggests JS-rendered code blocks invisible to crawlers, impacting discoverability
28 unverified links due to auth/rate-limit/server blocks may hide additional broken links
16.24% SEO/GEO issue rate harms search discoverability and organic traffic acquisition
Only 41.97% freshness coverage leaves 58% of pages with unknown staleness, risking outdated content usage
API confidence at 55% indicates moderate uncertainty in API documentation assessment accuracy

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 98 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation
Add usage examples, request/response samples, and integration code to 619 API pages to achieve minimum 60% reference coverage
Implement server-side rendering or static generation for code examples to ensure crawler visibility and resolve 0% example reliability
Add last-updated timestamps to remaining 58% of pages lacking freshness metadata
Resolve 16.24% SEO/GEO issues (missing meta descriptions, title tags, canonical URLs) to improve search rankings

limitations: External audit cannot verify content accuracy, technical correctness, or whether code examples actually execute successfully
28 unverified links blocked by authentication, rate limiting, or server errors may include additional broken links not counted
0% example reliability likely reflects JS-rendering detection limitation rather than true absence; manual sampling required to confirm actual example presence
Audit cannot assess documentation completeness, clarity, or alignment with actual product features and API behavior
Freshness timestamps only indicate last edit date, not whether content remains accurate or relevant to current product version
